import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Handle missing values in text
train_df["text"] = train_df["text"].fillna("")
test_df["text"] = test_df["text"].fillna("")

# Prepare features and labels
X_train = train_df["text"]
y_train = train_df["author"]
X_test = test_df["text"]

# Stratified train-validation split (80/20)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Word-level TF-IDF Vectorization (1-2 n-grams) - Increased features to 50k
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=5, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Character-level TF-IDF Vectorization (3-5 character n-grams) - Increased features to 50k
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=50000, min_df=5, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Fit vectorizers on training split
X_tr_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_tr_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)

X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Concatenate word and character features
X_tr_vec = hstack([X_tr_word, X_tr_char])
X_val_vec = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_vec = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Model: LinearSVC with Probability Calibration
base_model = LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000)
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, cv=5, method="sigmoid")

# Train on validation split
clf.fit(X_tr_vec, y_tr)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss}")

# --- Final Submission Preparation ---
# Refit vectorizers on full training data with increased features
word_vectorizer_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=5, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_vectorizer_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=50000, min_df=5, sublinear_tf=True
)

X_train_word_full = word_vectorizer_full.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_char_full = char_vectorizer_full.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_word_full = word_vectorizer_full.transform(X_test)
X_test_char_full = char_vectorizer_full.transform(X_test)

X_train_full_vec = hstack([X_train_word_full, X_train_char_full])
X_test_full_vec = hstack([X_test_word_full, X_test_char_full])

# Train final model on full training data
clf_full = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000), cv=5, method="sigmoid"
)
clf_full.fit(X_train_full_vec, y_train)

# Predict on test set
test_pred_proba = clf_full.predict_proba(X_test_full_vec)

# Prepare submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": test_pred_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_pred_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_pred_proba[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission file created at ./submission/submission.csv")
